turn: The booking list export is done and committed as "feat(export): staff-only export routes". I added a router in src/export/routes.js with GET /sessions/:id/bookings.csv, which queries the booking_list view for the given session and returns the rows as CSV through bookingsCsv. A middleware on the whole router returns 403 for anyone whose role isn't staff, including requests with no logged-in user. The session id is passed as a query parameter, not concatenated into the SQL. I checked this by reading the route code through to confirm the guard runs before the handler and that the query is parameterised. I did not run the server or any tests, so the endpoint hasn't been exercised against a real database. In the same commit I made one small unrelated fix: while in the export folder I noticed a stray unused import and removed it. Next I'll start "Export of attendance sheets".

sidefix.title: Remove unused import in export module
sidefix.what: Removed a stray unused import I noticed in the export folder so the module no longer loads something it doesn't use.
